title: AI NORTH STAR: smart enemies (patrols, search, teamwork, fire cohesion)
description:
Caleb, 2026-07-08 - the make-or-break directive for the whole game:

'highly intelligent and smart enemies is what will make or break this game. they need patrol routes, a tough searching mechanism when you are evading them, teamwork and firing cohesion. the NVA were not militarily strong but made up in determination and tactics.'

State today (post FOV-blindness fix):
- PERCEPTION now works: FOV cone + close-sense bubble + idle sentry scan; alert tiers RELAXED/SUSPICIOUS/ALERT/COMBAT; NoiseBus hearing; last-known-position investigate.
- Cover: dynamic cover-point discovery + claim broker exist (R15) but need real tuning against the combat lab.
- Navmesh: enemies path around structures (NavBaker, this session).
- GAPS to build toward the vision:
  1. PATROL ROUTES - trail-following exists (R18) but bare EnemyBase.spawn_enemy has no route; the mission generator should assign routes + sentry posts with real facings.
  2. SEARCH when evading - after losing LOS, escalate a COORDINATED sweep of the last-known area (breadcrumbs, spread search, flush cover), not just walk to one point. This is 'the tough searching mechanism'.
  3. TEAMWORK - squad-level coordination: bounding overwatch (one moves while one covers - R62 exists as a stub), suppress-while-flank, don't all pick the same cover (claim broker helps), call out contacts.
  4. FIRE COHESION - volley/focus-fire a spotted target, not independent plinking; hold fire until the point man triggers; concentrate on the nearest threat.
  5. DETERMINATION - morale that does NOT break easily for NVA regulars (vs VC militia that does); press even when hurt (retreats_when_hurt=false for NVA, already set).
This is the tuning target for the combat lab. Everything else (art, missions) is scaffolding around whether the firefight feels like fighting thinking soldiers.

description:
Caleb: 'theres a chirpping bird constantly... if we do birds we need a few different bird calls and they need to have a real kinda melody. the helicoptor whirl noise is great but keep it to the location of the heli model not just the player.'

VERIFIED:

title: PROVEN: R88 seed replay loads a different world than you played

title: AUDIT-13: test suite wrote to the player's real user://campaign.cfg
description:

reset_campaign() is called by FIVE test files - test_campaign_state:11, test_xp_spend:11,61, test_squad:10,131, test_firebase_sim:52, test_huey_ride:22,112 - and test_full_loop instantiates the real main.tscn GameFlow and runs three missions to debrief, firing game_flow.gd:190 CampaignState.on_mission_end() -> save_campaign().

title: AUDIT-01: Barracks can only ever sell the player 'small_arms'
description:
campaign_state.gd:17 hardcodes player_data.mos='RIFLEMAN'. barracks.gd:60 derives ONE purchasable skill from MOS via SkillCatalog.MOS_SKILL. MOS_SKILL['RIFLEMAN']='small_arms'. So the player can never buy fo_fac, demolitions, silent_movement, medic, detect_ambush, sniping.

Consequence: 4 of the 6 player_skill() read sites are structurally pinned to 0 forever -
  mission_director.gd:196  player_skill('fo_fac')        -> CAS turnaround never improves
  mission_generator.gd:352 player_skill('demolitions')   -> plant speed never improves
  plant_charge.gd:28       player_skill('demolitions')   -> player never spots trap wires
  player.gd:426            player_skill('silent_movement') -> footstep radius never shrinks

Also: 'detect_ambush' is buyable by POINT but read NOWHERE (squad_system.gd:181 uses raw 'al'). 'sniping' (skill_catalog.gd:13) is neither buyable nor read - pure fiction.
Only medic is cross-wired correctly (squad_system.gd:151 reads the medic's own member dict).

WAVE3_REPORT.md:17 and PLAYER_MANUAL.md:32 both claim 'every purchase does something real'. False.
Fix: let the player buy from the full catalog, or route ally skill purchases into the systems that read them.

title: [epic] CAPTURE: downed -> POW -> escape / bribe / rescue / suicide / wait-it-out
description:
Caleb's design, 2026-07-08. The strongest idea in the batch. It converts 'you died, reload' into 'the campaign continues without you, and you are somewhere else.' That IS Pillar 5 (fail forward), taken further than the medic chain.

CAPTURE TRIGGER (elegant, and mostly already built):
- You go DOWN, not dead. health_system.gd already has the downed state + bleed timer + squad revive chain (squad_system.gd:117-160).
- An enemy stands over you for ~5s -> CAPTURED.
- Caleb's key insight: your whole team need NOT be dead. They just have to fail to reach you while a man is standing on you. The 5s window is the drama. A squadmate can shoot him off you.
- This makes the existing revive chain a RACE, not a formality.

OUTCOMES (POW camp):
1. ESCAPE - break out. RESCUE mission type already has a camp, cage and guards (W48) - invert it, you are in the cage.
2. BRIBE - buy your way out. NEEDS THE MONEY ECONOMY (see the RPG loop epic).
3. RESCUED - another RECON squad comes for you. Scripted to start, then LIVE gameplay: the rescue team can LOSE. Deliciously grim.
4. SUICIDE - end it yourself. Deer Hunter russian roulette scene requested.
5. WAIT IT OUT - the war ends around you. THIS IS AN ENDING. A real one.

CONTENT WARNING / DESIGN GATE: russian roulette, suicide-as-mechanic, and (from the Battle Director epic) a child suicide bomber are three separate hard-content decisions. They can be done with restraint and enormous power, or they can be edgelord garbage. This needs a War Room with the writer and the devil's advocate BEFORE any of it is implemented. Do not let it arrive by accident inside a feature commit.

REUSE - VERIFIED: C:/Users/caleb/CatacombsOfGore (project name 'Broken Provinces') has scripts/autoload/bounty_manager.gd, data/bounty_templates*.json, and data/items/jail_key.tres. That is a BOUNTY/reputation system with a jail, not a capture state machine - the reusable part is the bounty/faction-standing model and the jail-key/escape scaffolding, not a drop-in POW system. Read it before assuming.

title: [epic] RIDE OR WALK: player-chosen approach, with a patrol-density consequence
description:
Caleb's design, 2026-07-08: 'the player can choose to ride a vehicle on land to the objective, or just walk it... if they walk out of the gate it says something like "looks like were huffing it" and it will initially keep the patrols down until the first contact.'

Why this is good: it makes Pillar 3 (freedom, no rails) a MECHANICAL choice with a real tradeoff, not a flavour one. Vehicle = fast, loud, road-bound, ambushable, mines. Foot = slow, quiet, off-road, and the AO starts cold.

MECHANIC: an approach modifier on MissionDirector's escalation pool.
- FOOT: patrol density x0.5 until first contact, then it normalises (the hunter escalation from CONTENT+COMBAT WAVE already models 'after first blood').
- VEHICLE: full density from t=0, but you arrive with time and stamina banked; road-bound so the ambush deck (RealVietnamRTS ambush_manager.gd) gets its moment.

ASSETS: M35 truck + M113 GLBs already imported (NS05). destructible_vehicle.gd already exists. Drivable is rework, not new.
NOTE: 'looks like we're huffing it' is exactly the right register. Squad barks carry this, not a UI toast.

DEPENDS ON: Step 6 navmesh (a vehicle needs a road network to follow, and R33 trail rendering is still unbuilt - only the patrol half of R33 shipped).

title: [epic] BATTLE DIRECTOR: campaign-reactive dynamic events
description:
Caleb's design, 2026-07-08. RTS-style director for the campaign layer, not just the tactical one.

CORE: the campaign already has the state a director needs - CampaignState.threat_level w/ decaying modifiers, team_xp, roster, intel_points, mission_log, missions_played. Today it only nudges AA density. Make it drive EVENTS.

Shape: after each debrief, the director rolls against campaign state and may inject a mutation into the NEXT departure:
- FIREBASE ASSAULT: you were doing well -> the AO answers. Big wave hits the firebase before you deploy. (FIREBASE_DEFENSE already exists as a mission type - reuse it as an EVENT, not an offer.)
- TERROR ATTACK: a sapper/child suicide bomber inside the wire. Deliberately ugly. Needs a hard content conversation before it ships.
- AMBUSHED CONVOY / MEDEVAC / DOWNED PILOT nearby -> a divert.
- QUIET WEEK: nothing. The director must be allowed to do nothing, or every return-to-base becomes a cutscene.

PRESSURE VALVE: this is where the RPG loop lands (see the money/shop epic). Success raises heat; heat raises event odds; events cost you men and materiel; you spend XP+money to recover. That is the loop.

DEPENDS ON: Step 4 determinism (a director rolling on the global RNG cannot be tested, replayed, or bisected). Do NOT build this before MissionRNG.
DEPENDS ON: Step 3 MissionScope (events fire across mission boundaries; static leakage will make them behave differently on mission 5 than mission 1).

The RTS project's ai_director.gd (RealVietnamRTS battle_system/ai/) is the design seed - encounter pacing + doctrine. Read it before writing this.

title: stamp_firebase() ignores its rng - every firebase is identical
description:

title: AUDIT-12: combat_sting.wav leaks at exit (AudioStreamWAV still in use)
description:
Surfaced the moment run_all_tests.ps1 stopped piping stderr to Out-Null (Step 1).

godot --headless --verbose res://tests/test_mission_state.tscn reports:
  WARNING: ObjectDB instances leaked at exit
  Leaked instance: AudioStreamWAV:...      Reference count: 1
  Leaked instance: AudioStreamPlaybackWAV:... Reference count: 1
  ERROR: 1 resources still in use at exit.
  Resource still in use: res://assets/audio/sfx/combat_sting.wav (AudioStreamWAV)

Affects test_detection (1), test_mission_state (1), test_full_loop (2).

Root cause is AUDIT #17: GunFX parents its AudioStreamPlayer3D to get_tree().current_scene, which is main.tscn's GameFlow root - it SURVIVES _teardown_world(). The sting player relies on 'finished -> queue_free' and is still playing when the engine exits.

Fix with the Step 3 MissionScope work: parent FX to the world node, or have GunFX track and free its players on teardown. Same class as cas_airplane.gd:101,117 FireHazard.create_at(get_tree().current_scene, ...) with dur up to 40s.

Harness: run_all_tests.ps1 reports these as verdict LEAK (loud, non-fatal) via $BenignPatterns. NOT whitelisted into silence - a LEAK verdict is printed per-test and summarised. Do not add entries to $BenignPatterns to make a build green.
close_reason: Step 3: GunFX combat sting tracked + freed in MissionScope.reset(). Remaining LEAK verdicts are the same audio outliving a headless quit - non-fatal.

title: AUDIT-08: QualitySettings detects your GPU, picks a preset, changes nothing
description:
